snapshot: Canada pregame notebook · October 6, 2026. Clubs: federation window context and later call-up releases. International caps/goals are not asserted here.

players.name: Jonathan David
facts: Scored the winner against Chile at 12 minutes.

analysis.strength: Movement between midfield and centre-backs can precede a second run into the box.
analysis.question: Does the dropping movement draw a defender before the next run?
analysis.watch: His second movement after connecting the attack.

players.name: Jacob Shaffelburg
facts: Scored both goals against Peru, at 19 and 35 minutes.

analysis.strength: A wide runner arriving beyond the ball can turn a regain into depth.
analysis.question: Who sees the run while the first defender is drawn toward the ball?
analysis.watch: The far-side run after Canada wins possession.

players.name: Stephen Eustáquio
facts: Listed with Swansea City in the federation’s window context.

analysis.strength: The first forward pass after a regain can exploit a defence before it resets.
analysis.question: Can the U.S. make him receive facing his own goal?
analysis.watch: His body orientation and the first pass after possession changes.

players.name: Nathan Saliba
facts: Started both completed matches in this window.

analysis.strength: The second midfield connection links pressure with the next attacking action.
analysis.question: Who supports the first presser and protects the space behind?
analysis.watch: The second pass and the covering position as teammates go forward.

players.name: Tani Oluwaseyi
facts: A former Minnesota player, now listed at Villarreal.

analysis.strength: Runs behind a stepping defender can stretch the first line of pressure.
analysis.question: Does the forward run create room for another player to receive short?
analysis.watch: Pressure on the first U.S. pass, then the run once Canada wins it.

analysis.strength: An opposite-side outlet can matter as the defence shifts toward the ball.
analysis.question: When should he stay wide rather than join the ball-side combination?
analysis.watch: The outlet left behind as Canada pulls the defence across.

players.name: Niko Sigur
facts: Listed at Toulouse in the federation’s window context.

analysis.strength: A defender advancing behind pressure can keep the team compact.
analysis.question: What space appears behind that advance?
analysis.watch: His support of pressure and the U.S. option into the vacated channel.

players.name: Richie Laryea
facts: Listed at Toronto FC in the federation’s window context.

analysis.strength: The timing of a wide defender’s arrival can change the attacking numbers.
analysis.question: Can the recovery begin before the U.S. switch reaches the far side?
analysis.watch: His arrival into attack and his first recovery steps.

players.name: Luc de Fougerolles
players.club: Real Salt Lake · loan from Fulham

analysis.strength: A centre-back may contest a dropping receiver before that player can turn.
analysis.question: Follow the forward, or preserve the space behind?
analysis.watch: The cover accompanying his decision to step up.

players.name: Ralph Priso
facts: Vancouver confirms his starts against Chile and Peru.

analysis.strength: The other defender’s position determines whether a step into midfield is protected.
analysis.question: Who takes responsibility for the space the first challenger leaves?
analysis.watch: The other side of the defensive step-up.

players.name: Dayne St. Clair
facts: Started against Chile. A former Minnesota player.

analysis.strength: Goalkeeper involvement can create another passing option against the U.S. press.
analysis.question: Is the next pass prepared for the receiver, or merely away from pressure?
analysis.watch: The goalkeeper’s starting position and first decision.

players.name: Marcus Caldeira
facts: Minnesota records five goals and three assists in 11 first-team appearances, all competitions, at its published snapshot.

analysis.strength: The club profile identifies near-post runs, headers and poacher-style finishes.
analysis.question: What is his first senior job if used from the bench?
analysis.watch: The first move across a defender before the delivery.

players.name: Theo Corbeanu
facts: Joined the camp after the Buchanan and Larin withdrawals.

analysis.strength: An additional wide option can change the route into the final third.
analysis.question: Will he supply width or play as an advanced second-line attacker?
analysis.watch: The role Marsch actually gives him; a late call-up is not a starting prediction.
